description: This file contains utility functions for handling recipe images, including providing a placeholder image and normalizing image URLs for consistent referencing in a React project.

methods.name: getPlaceholder(kind = "card")
methods.description: Returns an imported placeholder image for recipes, with an optional kind parameter to specify the placeholder type.

methods.name: normalizeRecipeImage(src)
methods.description: Converts various input image URLs into a safe, absolute path suitable for the CRA development environment, falling back to placeholder if necessary.
